one.title: How do I sign up?
one.content: Signing up is easy! Simply visit our registration page, fill out the required information, and submit your application. You'll receive a confirmation email once your account is activated.

two.title: Can I promote campaigns?

three.title: What are affiliate campaigns?

four.title: How do I get paid?

six.title: How to share selected campaigns?

one.title: How does it work?
one.desc: Our platform connects brands with athletes and teams to create affiliate marketing campaigns. Brands publish promotions, which athletes can share with their fans. This creates a win-win situation for everyone involved.

two.title: Who can join?
two.desc: Any brand looking to promote their products or services can join our platform. Additionally, athletes and teams can sign up to promote these campaigns. It's an inclusive space for all sports enthusiasts.

three.title: What are the fees?
three.desc: There are no upfront fees – you only pay based on the results achieved. Brands set the commission structure for their campaigns, and our platform applies a fixed commission rate based on your chosen fee structure. For more information on pricing, please contact our support team.

four.title: How to promote campaigns?
four.desc: Athletes can promote campaigns through their social media channels and on our platform. We provide tools and resources to help them effectively share promotions. Engaging content leads to better results.

five.title: Can I track results?
five.desc: Yes, our platform offers analytics tools to track the performance of your campaigns. Brands can see engagement metrics and conversion rates. This data helps optimize future promotions for better success.

six.title: Can I connect my Shopify webshop?
six.desc: Absolutely! Connect your Shopify store in just a few clicks with our seamless Shopify app integration. Once linked, your products will be ready to share and support ambassadors. Sign up, then head to your account dashboard under ‘My Campaigns’ for step-by-step instructions.

frequentData.title: Frequently Asked Questions
frequentData.para: Welcome to our FAQ page! Here, you'll find answers to common questions about our platform, helping you navigate your experience with ease.

one.question: What is this platform all about?
one.answer: This is where sports meets shopping. Athletes and creators recommend products they trust and you can shop directly through their links to support them. It's a new way to discover products and back the athletes you love.

two.question: Do I need an account to use the platform?
two.answer: No account is required to shop. But if you want to follow athletes, save your favorite products and get campaign updates, creating a free account enhances your experience.

three.question: How do athletes earn money here?
three.answer: When you shop through an ambassador's link, they earn a commission at no extra cost to you. It's like giving back for their content, passion and recommendations.

four.question: Is it more expensive to shop through the platform?
four.answer: Not at all. You'll always pay the same price as you would on the brand's website. The difference? Your favorite athlete earns when you buy through their link.

five.question: What is affiliate marketing?
five.answer: Affiliate marketing is a performance-based marketing strategy where brands reward affiliates for promoting their product, services or brand itself. In our case, ambassadors promote campaigns and earn commissions on sales generated through their efforts. It's a win-win for everyone involved!

one.question: How do I sign up?
one.answer: Signing up is easy! To get started, simply register using your email address. Then, complete the onboarding steps to tell us about yourself and fill in the required profile details. Once your profile is complete, you'll gain access to your personal dashboard and can start exploring campaigns right away.

two.question: How do I earn money as an ambassador?
two.answer: You earn a commission whenever someone shops through your unique campaign link or even just clicks it. The more engagement you generate, the more you can earn. Each campaign description includes details on the commission rates offered by the brand.

three.question: What are affiliate campaigns?
three.answer: Affiliate campaigns are marketing partnerships where brands collaborate with ambassadors to promote their products or drive traffic to specific pages. Depending on the campaign, ambassadors can earn commissions either from sales generated through their unique links or simply from clicks. It’s a mutually beneficial way to grow visibility and results together.

four.question: How do I get paid?
four.answer: Payments are processed through our platform on a monthly basis. Once you reach the minimum payout threshold, your earnings will be transferred to your personal Stripe account. From there, Stripe will automatically send the funds to your linked bank account. This transfer usually takes a few business days.

five.question: Who can join?
five.answer: Anyone who is elevating the world of sports can join our platform! Whether you're an athlete, team, club, sport influencer or a coach looking to monetize your influence, we welcome you to sign up and start connecting with your fans.

six.question: How to share selected campaigns?
six.answer: You can share individual links or use your ambassador storefront, a sharable profile with all your campaigns in one place.

faqDataBrand.para: Find answers to common questions about our platform and how it benefits brands.

one.question: What is this platform?
one.answer: Sbonssy is a platform designed to promote an active lifestyle and create opportunities for success in sports, from the grassroots level all the way to international stars. On our platform, you’ll find products and brands recommended by your favorite athletes. By purchasing through us, you support the athlete of your choice—at no extra cost to you!

two.question: Do I need an account to shop?
two.answer: Nope! But creating a free fan account lets you follow ambassadors, save favorites and get notified about new campaigns.

three.question: How do I support an ambassador?
three.answer: Every time you shop through an ambassador’s unique link, they earn a commission from the brand — no extra cost to you. It’s an easy way to turn your normal shopping into real support for athletes. Head to an athlete’s profile, browse their favorite picks, and shop through their recommendations. With Sbonssy, your everyday purchases can help ambassadors chase their dreams and succeed.

four.question: Is it more expensive to shop through an ambassador?
four.answer: Not at all. Prices are exactly the same as on the brand’s website. The difference is that when you shop through an ambassador’s link, the brand rewards them with a commission allowing you to support athletes at no extra cost to you.

five.question: Does my purchase really make a difference?
five.answer: Absolutely! Even small actions can make a real difference. Every purchase made through an ambassador’s link helps them earn directly from the brand. That income can go toward training, travel, gear, or simply keeping their dream alive. You’re not just buying something — you’re choosing to stand behind someone.

six.question: What if I have an issue with my order?
six.answer: Orders are completed on the brand’s website. For returns or any issues, please contact the brand directly using the details in your order confirmation email.

step1.heading: Campaign Basics
step1.subHeading: Tell us a bit about your campaign so we can help you reach the right creators.
step1.label: Campaign Type
step1.para1: Write a short title for your campaign, e.g., 'Sbonssy services -20%'. No discount? No problem. You can also use something like: 'New collection now in our online store' or 'Free delivery on orders over €50'. The campaign title will be displayed on the public marketplace.

step1.para2: We recommend using your brand logo. Cover image will be shown on public marketplace.

typePara.one: Campaign is open to all registered sport ambassadors, and any of them can begin promoting it immediately.
typePara.two: Sports ambassadors need to apply, and it's up to you to decide who gets to start promoting.
typePara.three: Only you and the sport ambassadors you invite will be able to see the campaign.

step2.heading: Compensation Structure
step2.subHeading: Pick how you'd like to reward creators for bringing in traffic, leads, or sales.

HowItWorksSection.subtitle: Choose your role to see how you can get started on our platform.

ambassadors.label: Ambassadors
ambassadors.heading: Monetize Your Influence

step1.title: Sign Up & Create Your Profile
step1.description: Ambassadors join in minutes. Set up your profile, tell us who you are and unlock your personalized dashboard.

step2.title: Discover & Share Campaigns
step2.description: Discover brand partnerships, build your own storefront and share unique links your fans will love.

step3.title: Earn & Track Your Impact
step3.description: Turn your influence into income. Earn commissions from fan engagement and monitor your performance with real-time analytics.

ambassadors.description: Earn commissions when your fans shop through your links. No sales pressure, just authentic recommendations that benefit all.

brands.label: Brands
brands.heading: Scale Through Sports

step1.title: Sign Up & Create a Campaign
step1.description: Create your account and build a campaign in minutes. Add what you want ambassadors to promote, set commissions and choose your access settings.

step2.title: Partner with Sport Ambassadors
step2.description: Get discovered by verified athletes, teams and sport creators. Launch at scale by activating multiple ambassadors to reach diverse fanbases.

step3.title: Track & Optimize Performance
step3.description: Monitor clicks, conversions, and revenue in real time. Use live insights to refine campaigns and maximize ROI — only pay when it works.

brands.description: Commission based model means you invest in actual conversions, not impressions. Real ROI, real growth.

fans.label: Fans
fans.heading: Support Made Simple

step1.title: Discover Ambassadors You Love
step1.description: Browse athletes, teams and sport creators. Explore their profiles and discover authentic recommendations they personally stand behind.

step2.title: Shop Through Their Recommendations
step2.description: Find gear, services and offers shared by your favorite ambassadors. You'll shop directly on the brand's website — same products, same prices.

step3.title: Support Them at No Extra Cost
step3.description: Every time you shop through an ambassador's link, they earn a commission from the brand. You get what you love, and they get rewarded.

fans.description: Find what sport-minded people recommend, choose who to support and shop directly from brand stores.
